value.name: reflects on the work's purpose
value.description: Asha sits in the kitchen and realizes that the work she has done here was meant to preserve the house and family.
evidence: that, Asha thought, sitting in the kitchen of a house she had once helped to keep from being sold, was what the work had been for.

value.name: finishes coffee and stands up
value.description: Asha finishes her coffee and gets up from the kitchen table.
evidence: She finished her coffee. She got up.

value.name: rinses cup as taught by Rosa
value.description: Asha rinses her cup and puts it upside down on the rack, following Rosa's old instruction that marked her as part of the house rather than a guest.
evidence: She put her cup in the sink, the way Rosa had taught her, the first time she had ever stayed for lunch, by simply taking the cup out of her hand and rinsing it and setting it upside down on the rack and not saying anything about it, which had been Rosa's way of saying, *you are not a guest here anymore, you are a person, and persons rinse their cups.* She rinsed it now. She set it upside down on the rack.

value.name: returns to sit with Lucia and Daniel
value.description: Asha goes back into the dining room and sits across from Lucia and Daniel, resuming the shared waiting that defines her role.
evidence: Then she went back into the dining room, where Lucia and Daniel were sitting on the same side of the table, the way they had sat that Monday morning years ago, and she sat down across from them, at the place where she had sat the day they had closed the estate, and she waited with them, because waiting with people was, in the end, the largest part of what she did, and the part she had become, over a long career that had begun in earnest in this house, best at.

value.name: house shelters the gathered family
value.description: The house is described as holding Asha, Lucia, Daniel, and the family history they embody, suggesting its enduring protective role.
evidence: The house held them, as it had held the woman who had built her family inside it and the woman who had kept that family running and the two children who had not always known what to do with either of them, and it would, Asha thought, hold them a whil
participants: the woman who had built her family inside it
the woman who had kept that family running
